chunks: "Whoever performs three hajj pilgrimages will never be afflicted by poverty."
ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of performing hajj three times?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages repeated hajj by describing it as a cause of protection from poverty. It highlights the spiritual and worldly blessing associated with devotion in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever performs three Hajj will never experience poverty."
